facts.fact: 开头：Simone 广播宣布有坏消息，烟花表演取消。
facts.anchor: I hate to be a buzzkill, but I have some bad news. Our fireworks extravaganza is cancelled due to

facts.fact: 烟花取消原因是浮船设备故障，园方致歉并希望尽快重新安排。
facts.anchor: an equipment malfunction on the floating barge. We apologize and hope to reschedule the event soon.

facts.fact: 安保团队正在追踪岛上的可疑活动。
facts.anchor: Also, our security team is tracking some suspicious activity on the island.

facts.fact: 广播称这只是小调查，暂不能透露细节，请大家不要恐慌。
facts.anchor: While I can’t get into any further details now, I can reassure you that it’s a minor investigation and there’s no cause for alarm.

facts.fact: 为配合安保工作，要求所有客人在天黑前返回自己的房间。
facts.anchor: in order for security to do their job, we’re asking all guests to return to their rooms before dark

facts.fact: 结尾：客人须留在房间直到早晨，Simone 以感谢合作结束广播。
facts.anchor: asking all guests to return to their rooms before dark and remain there until morning.
